summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of SIMAPAN. 16/16 pytest cases passing (auth, dashboard, inmates CRUD + QR, locations CRUD + QR, settings incl. category rename, activity scan + approve + reject + Excel export, users management with role gating, audit logs). Playwright end-to-end: admin login → CRUD inmate/lokasi → barcode grid → settings category rename → verify new label appears in Activities filter → operator login redirects to /scan with assigned location pre-filled → manual barcode scan (WB-2024-0001) → confirm + submit succeeds with success toast → operator blocked from /users (redirected to /scan) → supervisor approvals page allows approve/reject. Fixed one backend serialization bug found during testing.

minor.issue: Returned 500 because audit_log records store nested Mongo docs whose '_id' fields (leaked by insert_one mutation in log_audit callers for inmates/activities/locations) are not JSON-serializable. Only top-level _id was stripped by projection. FIXED by adding recursive _strip_ids sanitizer in list_audit endpoint. Root cause remains: log_audit callers should pop '_id' from 'after' payloads BEFORE persisting (e.g. inmates.create passes doc after insert_one). Recommend fix at source too.

design_issues.screen: Multiple dialogs (Inmates form, Users form, Activity detail)
issues: Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — a11y hint, non-blocking.

action_items: Consider fixing log_audit callers (inmates create/update, locations create/update, activities create) to strip '_id' from 'after'/'before' payloads before persisting to audit_log — currently mitigated only on read.
Add aria-describedby (or DialogDescription) to all DialogContent components to silence Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:606 — 'doc' passed to log_audit still contains '_id' from insert_one mutation; nested _id leaks into audit_log storage (same for inmates.create/update, locations.create/update).
server.py:547,634 — date_to concatenation uses Python precedence 'a + b if cond else c' which currently evaluates '(a + b) if cond else c' — reads as intended but fragile; consider explicit parens.
server.py:24 — CORS default '*' + allow_credentials=True is not spec-compliant; explicit origins recommended (env CORS_ORIGINS is '*' currently).
ScanPage.jsx — html5-qrcode instantiated inside effect starts even when running=false may race with strict-mode double-invoke; consider a stable init guard.
server.py file is 921 lines — should be split into routers/modules (auth, inmates, activities, locations, users, settings, audit).
seed_data_creation: Backend seeded automatically on startup: 3 inmates (WB-2024-0001..0003), 6 locations incl. Masjid At-Taubah, admin+supervisor+operator1. Test suite creates TEST_* prefixed data and cleans up after itself.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_simapan.py is idempotent and covers full CRUD + role gating + export. Frontend has consistent data-testid attributes across pages. Reject flow requires ≥1 pending activity — run operator scan first to create fresh submissions before testing reject in isolation. Camera not available in headless — always use scan-manual-code-input.
rca of the issue: Audit-logs 500: log_audit(inmates create, etc.) writes 'after' dict which retains '_id' (ObjectId) because motor's insert_one mutates the passed dict. Projection {"_id":0} in read query only removes top-level _id, not nested. FastAPI's default JSON encoder fails on ObjectId → ValueError. Mitigation applied: recursive strip on read. Proper fix: strip _id in log_audit before storing OR use jsonable_encoder / pop _id in each caller after insert_one.
